services.descriptionEn: Natural nails · Solid colour or two colours
Natural nails · Solid colour, two colours, or cat-eye

active.descriptionEn: Book a qualifying nail appointment during August 2026 and receive one complimentary future appointment for a comparable style. Redeem your complimentary visit whenever you’re ready.
active.descriptionZh: 于 2026 年 8 月预约一次符合条件的美甲服务，即可获赠一次同等相似款式的免费美甲。赠送服务可在未来任意时间预约使用。
active.termsEn: Applies to comparable simple styles. Full rhinestone sets, complex nail art, 3D designs, sculpting, and other advanced styles are excluded.
active.termsZh: 适用于同等相似的简单款式。满钻、复杂彩绘、3D 立体造型、雕花及其他高难度款式不参与此优惠。
active.imageAltEn: Long coffin French extensions with hand-painted tortoiseshell and black polka dots
active.imageAltZh: 长款棺材形法式延长甲，搭配手绘玳瑁纹和黑色波点

perks.titleZh: 好友推荐 · 双倍优惠
perks.descriptionEn: Friends who book through your recommendation receive 12% off. Earn 10% off your next visit for each successful referral—two referrals earn 20%, and so on.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过您的推荐预约的朋友可享 12% 优惠。每成功推荐一位，您下次消费可享 10% 优惠；推荐两位享 20%，以此类推。

perks.descriptionEn: Receive 12% off when heavy rain, snowstorms, or other severe weather affects your appointment day.
perks.descriptionZh: 如预约当天遇到大雨、暴雪或其他恶劣天气，可享 12% 优惠。

active.descriptionEn: First-time clients receive 15% off their first full-set gel manicure.
active.descriptionZh: 首次光顾的新客享受第一次全套光疗美甲九折优惠。

active.descriptionEn: Add a gel pedicure to any manicure appointment and save $10.
active.descriptionZh: 在任何美甲预约中加购光疗足甲，立享$10优惠。

services.descEn: Long-lasting gel colour with or without nail art. Includes shaping, cuticle care, and top coat.
services.descZh: 持久光疗色彩，可添加指甲彩绘。包含修形、护理角质和封层。

services.descEn: Soothing foot soak, nail shaping, cuticle work, and gel colour application.
services.descZh: 舒缓泡脚、修甲、护理角质和光疗颜色涂抹。

services.descEn: Custom hand-painted designs, stamping, foils, gems, and 3D art — added to any service.
services.descZh: 定制手绘图案、印花、金箔、宝石和3D立体美甲 — 可添加至任何服务。

services.descEn: Add length with gel or acrylic extensions, then customise with any design.
services.descZh: 使用光疗或水晶延长指甲，然后搭配任意图案定制。

services.descEn: Safe professional removal of gel, acrylic, or dip powder sets. Gel infills also available.
services.descZh: 安全专业地卸除光疗胶、水晶甲或浸粉甲。同时提供光疗补甲服务。

services.descEn: Manicure and pedicure combined at a bundled price. Perfect for special occasions.
services.descZh: 手足美甲组合套餐，优惠价格。非常适合特殊场合。
